parse.description: Check a netlist with Xyce -norun (syntax and topology, no analysis) and report the model gaps of Xyce for it. Inputs: deck (relative to the design root), libs (optional list of {path, section}; each becomes a .lib line; $PDK_ROOT is expanded; the model libraries come from the caller, the adapter has no PDK facts), params and temp_c (optional, as for simulate). Findings, each a diagnostic with the file and line of the model card: model missing (a device without a model card that Xyce accepts, for example an unknown level) and parameter unrecognized (Xyce rejects a parameter of a model or a device, for example a PSP model card for another simulator) are errors, the model gaps; parameter ignored (Xyce drops a model parameter, for example a safe-operating limit) and version substituted (Xyce replaces an older model version by its oldest supported version) are warnings, the fidelity findings; a dot line that Xyce ignores is a warning that names the line. The response status is completed when Xyce ran, also when the netlist has errors. Measurements: model_gaps (the number of devices with a gap), fidelity_warnings, ignored_lines, netlist_errors, devices (the device count of Xyce; missing when the netlist did not reach the topology step). The report has the device count per type and level and one line per finding; work/parse.json has all of them. Use it once per simulator and model library before a campaign: a gap found late costs a campaign.

simulate.description: Run one Xyce simulation of a deck (the deck holds the circuit, the analysis and the .measure and .print lines; .ac, .tran, .dc, .op, .lin). Inputs: deck, libs (optional list of {path, section}), params (optional {name: number or string}) and temp_c (optional number): the adapter writes them BEFORE the deck as .param lines and '.options device temp=', because Xyce keeps the first definition of a parameter and of the temperature and silently ignores a later one; measurements (optional {name: unit}: names of .measure results, read from the .measure files of Xyce, case-insensitive; a name that Xyce did not write is missing, a FAILED measure is failed). Refusals (status failed, no run): a .temp line in the deck or its design includes (Xyce ignores .temp with only a warning, so the run would be at 27 C: use temp_c), and a YLIN device with a .ac, .tran, .lin, .dc or .op analysis (Xyce treats YLIN as an open circuit there with no warning; use the touchstone adapter, fit_to_spice). A .LIN analysis writes a Touchstone file: it is an output with the role touchstone, and the kernel adds its summary (ports, band, passivity, reciprocity); a requirement of kind s_db or mu reads it. The runs use -redefined_params usefirst. Open MPI start-up failures are retried twice. Measurements: the requested .measure values. Diagnostics: the netlist errors and warnings of the log with file and line, and the model findings of parse.

hb.description: Harmonic balance in Xyce, one Xyce process per sweep point. Inputs: deck (the circuit; the adapter removes .control blocks, analyses, .print, .measure, .step and .options hbint, and lists what it removed), libs, params, temp_c (as for simulate), tones (required, Hz, one or more), harmonics (per tone, an integer or a list; default 25), startup_periods (default 10; transient periods before HB, which large-drive circuits need), ports (required: {name: {node, ref (default 0), r_ohm}}: the voltage across the port and the load resistance give the power), products (the mixing products to report: {name: [m1, m2, ...]} at m1 f1 + m2 f2 + ...; default h1, h2, h3 for one tone; required for two tones), dc_currents (optional, voltage source names: the DC current, positive into the + node), sweep (optional {param, values, available_power_dbm}: one point per value of a .param; with available_power_dbm true the values are the available input power in dBm, and the response has the gain and P1dB), wall_s_per_point (default 600: a point without a result in this time is stopped, status timeout), parallel (default 1: points at the same time). Each point is converged, failed (Xyce exit code), timeout, or missing (Xyce exited with 0 but a product or the output is not there: the silent failure class). Measurements: p_<port>_<product>_dbm and i_<source>_a; with a sweep, <name>.min and <name>.max with 'at', the sweep point, and every one is failed when any point did not converge; gain_<port>_db (.min/.max: P of the first product minus the available power), gain_ss_<port>_db (the gain at the lowest power), p1db_in_<port>_dbm and p1db_out_<port>_dbm (the 1 dB compression from the lowest point, interpolated between the two points that bracket it; failed when a point inside the bracket did not converge, missing when the sweep does not reach compression), points_converged, points_total. The response is failed when a point did not converge. work/hb.json has every point (status, reason, runtime, powers, currents, gain). A warning when no port has signal: Xyce HB has no autonomous (oscillator) mode and converges to the DC state with no error.
